# memories

> Café Moments. Lasting Loyalty. The loyalty, photobooth, and live wall platform for specialty coffee shops and independent venues.

## Overview
memories transforms casual coffee visits into lasting customer loyalty through zero-app photobooth experiences, ambient TV walls, and digital loyalty passes.

## Key Features
- Zero-App Photobooth: Guests scan a QR code on table coasters with standard mobile camera to capture memories.
- Live Community TV Wall: Curated guest photos broadcast to ambient 4K in-store displays with offline caching.
- Digital Loyalty Passes: Brand stories and reward stamps with automated fraud protection.
- Korean & Specialty Coffee Aesthetics: Life Four Cuts inspired vertical film strips, polaroids, and artisanal coasters.
